summary: Complete architectural and UX implementation plan for Discover Audio Radio & Agent Vault: a zero-mock, dynamically updated full-stack web & PWA application with SQLite deduplication, real Edge-TTS neural voice synthesis with pre-generation prosody hot-reloading, multi-source ingestion (RSS/Google News, Android Discover Webhook, Playwright exporter, and Custom URL/Screenshot Vision/Text), interactive paragraph-level "Read from here" scrubbing, and automated Markdown/JSON/Registry RAG + Podcast RSS exports.
